issues.title: Russian Drone Attack on Tanzania-Flagged Vessel in Ukraine
issues.title_en: Russian Drone Attack on Tanzania-Flagged Vessel in Ukraine
issues.summary: A Russian drone attack targeted a Tanzania-flagged vessel heading to Ukraine, resulting in the death of the captain and injuries to three crew members. The Ukrainian infrastructure ministry reported the incident and stated that the vessel's condition is currently being assessed.

issues.title: Vietnam's Quang Ninh police bust US$38.4mil transnational cybercrime ring
issues.title_en: Vietnam's Quang Ninh police bust US$38.4mil transnational cybercrime ring
issues.summary: HANOI: Quang Ninh City's Department of Public Security, in coordination with the Ministry of Public Security's Department of Cybersecurity and Hi-tech Crime Prevention (A05), has dismantled a major criminal ring involved in online fraud, illegal trading of personal data and money laundering, with the amount of money fraudulently appropriated estimated at over VNĐ1 trillion (US$38.4 million).
